alt: The Creature Cauldron page in its dark theme: a party and difficulty bar, a row of filters, and three boxes for results, the encounter and saved encounters, with a painted witch at the top right.
caption: The whole app on one page: party and difficulty on top, filters under them, and the library, the encounter and saved encounters below.

alt: The Source filter menu open, listing SRD 5.1, A5E, Curated samples, Generated and Reskin with a checkbox each.
caption: A Source filter narrows the 948 monsters to the ones from the SRD, from A5E, hand-written, generated by the AI, or reskinned.

alt: A stat block pop-out for the Adult Red Dragon on parchment, with armor class, hit points, speeds, ability scores, saves and the start of its actions, and buttons for Print, Favorite, Add to encounter, Reskin and Export.
caption: Every monster opens as a 2014-style stat block. The action text is built from structured data so the numbers always match the dice.

alt: The stat block for the A5E version of the Aboleth, with the credit for the A5E source at the bottom.
caption: A5E monsters are labelled and carry their licence credit. Their numbers follow A5E rather than the 2014 rules, and the page says so.

alt: The Reskin menu open on a Hill Giant with Remix selected, a Cold damage theme and the Lob signature move chosen, and a description of what the move does.
caption: Remix: pick a damage theme, a signature move from a menu of 18, a level up, or let the forge surprise you.

alt: The result of the remix: a Frost Hill Giant with a What changed list showing main damage changed to cold, now resists cold, now vulnerable to fire, and a new move called Glacial Lob.
caption: The result lists exactly what changed. The AI named the monster and the move; code changed the damage, defences and numbers.

alt: A Reflavored Ogre called Tidewrack Colossus with a What changed list showing its attacks renamed, and a new description of a creature of driftwood and rope.
caption: Reflavor changes only words: a new name, a new description and new names for its attacks, with every number as it was.

alt: The Polymorph panel on an Ogre with Giant Eagle chosen as the donor and a list of features it can lend: Fly 80 ft., Keen Sight, a Beak attack and a Talons attack, plus ticks for legendary actions and level up.
caption: Polymorph: choose a second creature and tick what the first one borrows, or let the forge choose. The list comes from the server without using the AI.

alt: The Stormwing Ogre, an ogre that flies at 80 feet and has Beak and Talons attacks, with a What changed list that includes legendary actions three a round.
caption: The hybrid keeps the ogre's own hit points and armor class. Borrowed attacks are fitted to its numbers so the challenge rating stays honest.

alt: A newly generated Tiny undead called the Sandwhisper Cantor with a note that it is generated and unchecked, and its traits, saves and challenge rating 3.
caption: Generate: filters in, a new original monster out. It passed the validator, was stored for everyone, and costs the owner about a third of a cent.

alt: The results box while a monster is being generated, with a painted cauldron rising in front of the page and the word Brewing.
caption: While the AI works, a painted cauldron bubbles. A generation takes a few seconds.

alt: The encounter box holding two Ogres, a Hill Giant and four Goblins, with seven monsters rated Deadly for four level 3 characters, the total XP, the multiplier and the adjusted XP.
caption: The encounter builder rates the fight live with the 2014 method: total XP, the multiplier for the number of monsters, and the difficulty for your party.

alt: The same page in the light theme: parchment colours, dark green accents and the same layout.
caption: A light theme, remembered between visits.

alt: The page on a phone: the title, party and difficulty buttons, the filter buttons wrapped over several rows and the start of the results list stacked in one column.
caption: On a phone everything stacks into one column.
